name: burrow
description: Read, search and edit LeafWiki pages with your own account, without overwriting anyone's changes.
long_description: burrow lets the AI read, search, write and organize pages on a [LeafWiki](https://github.com/perber/leafwiki). It signs in with your own account, so every change shows up under your name, and it never overwrites a change someone else made since your last read. Tool names start with `read_`, `write_` or `delete_`, so you can allow reading and ask before changes.

leafwiki_url.title: LeafWiki URL
leafwiki_url.description: Wiki root, e.g. https://wiki.example.com (https only, except localhost)

username.title: Username
username.description: Your LeafWiki username or email; leave empty if the wiki has no sign-in

password.title: Password
password.description: Its password (accounts with two-factor codes can't sign in)
